tutorialPages.messageText: NSLOCTEXT("[D20C99C24B2FABB4DC05E3BF1EE067C5]", "BBE6EA8749A8AFD10FB66098D219EE17", "Mayors can use empty plots to build new Settlement services. To start a new construction, select the plot to view what types of Service Buildings can be constructed in that location.")

NSLOCTEXT("[D20C99C24B2FABB4DC05E3BF1EE067C5]", "AD6DA0364B42217CA89BFCBBD3637067", "Before committing to a project, Mayors are able to review a building\'s services, construction costs, maintnence fees, and other important information. The Settlement needs enough required resources before construction can begin.")
NSLOCTEXT("[D20C99C24B2FABB4DC05E3BF1EE067C5]", "27157DE246DA73B4CC3A91830A162AAD", "Once construction has begun, citizens will help by donating required Construction Crates.")

NSLOCTEXT("[D20C99C24B2FABB4DC05E3BF1EE067C5]", "CC24ACB14FADBE18409EAAB9C924C263", "If not enough Construction Crates are donated in time, the construction will fail. Make sure to consider citizen\'s goals before starting a building project!")
